figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 5. The effect of emodin-8-O-glucoside (E-8-O-G) (5–200 µM) on the viability of SK-N-AS
neuroblastoma (A), T98G human glioblastoma (B), and C6 mouse glioblastoma (C) cells after 96 h
incubation in the MTT assay. Data are presented as mean ± standard deviation (±SD); one-way
ANOVA, Tukey post hoc testing; *** p < 0.001.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 6
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 6. The effect of emodin-8-O-glucoside (E-8-O-G) (1–150 µM) on the viability of SK-N-AS
neuroblastoma (A), T98G human glioblastoma (B) and C6 mouse glioblastoma (C) cells after 96 h
incubation in the CellTiter-Glo® assay. Data are presented as mean ± standard deviation (±SD);
one-way ANOVA, Tukey post hoc testing; *** p < 0.001.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 7
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 7. The effect of emodin-8-O-glucoside (E-8-O-G) (5–200 µM) on the proliferation of SK-N-AS
neuroblastoma (A), T98G human glioblastoma (B) and C6 mouse glioblastoma cells (C) after 96 h
incubation in the BrdU assay. Data are presented as mean ± standard deviation (±SD); one-way
ANOVA, Tukey post hoc testing; ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001.
